separateOwnSecurityFinding.mechanism: read() reads casesAgain and bindingAgain, then awaits authorizeCase(casesAgain.value.decision) and host.revalidate before returning the prior binding. A real C08 CAS removing participant/choice during that last authorizeCase can keep the supplied old snapshot authorized and global lease unchanged, so no subsequent case observation detects it.
separateOwnSecurityFinding.smallestOwnCorrection: Finish external authorizeCase/revalidate callbacks; explicitly reauthorize preferences read under sameAuthority and compare its binding; then observe decision/result/producer/private binding together from C08 under sameAuthority, compare all full digests/identities, and return without another product callback. No write permission is required for reads.
separateOwnSecurityFinding.discriminatingRegression: Two isolated reader regressions change membership via real C08 CAS or revoke only preferences read during the second preview-specific authorizeCase, while retaining a valid global UI lease. Both require stale/no value. The positive read first disables preferences write. C08 choice/binding are seeded, monetary values unknown, while UI admission, SQLite and result-store operations are real.
